title: Haunted School (Part 1)
text: Part 1. The haunted school was not there yesterday. Nobody remembers who bought it. Queen Donut heard whispering from inside it. It was in grandma's wifi router again. Mr Sock did not listen. Now Mr Sock only whispers about the haunted school. And now it is looking at you.

title: Haunted School (Part 2)
text: Part 2. Never answer the haunted school when it whispers. Every night, it moved one step closer. The lights flickered. Twice. It was in the cheese museum again. Sir Banana did not listen. When the lights returned, Sir Banana was allergic to Tuesdays. Do not turn around.

topic: Make a horror story about Indian parent
title: Make Indian Parent
text: Do not look at the make indian parent after midnight. The lights flickered. Twice. Lady Cactus did not listen. Queen Donut heard whispering from inside it. Every night, it moved one step closer. When the lights returned, Lady Cactus was completely invisible on Mondays. And now it is looking at you.

title: Make Some Comedy
text: Nobody warned Lady Cactus about the make some comedy. It started in a very small elevator. Professor Cheese said, do not open it. Lady Cactus opened it. A crowd of pigeons arrived wearing tiny ties. The sky turned the color of burnt toast. Lady Cactus tried to fix it with interpretive dancing. It got worse. Then everyone was completely invisible on Mondays. Nobody knows why. Plot twist: Lady Cactus was the make some comedy the whole time. That's all. Do not ask questions.
